data.text: I’m in on the same terms as Emma: 15 tons today, with the full $15,000 paid directly to the clinic, and 7.5 tons next month under the 30-ton group cap. My family depends on this lake, and our village depends on that clinic. This exception can work, but only if everyone commits to both months before we cast our nets. After recovery, let’s agree to keep total monthly catches at or below 50 tons while the lake is full. John, can you commit to the donation and recovery plan?
